subject: 清初至清中北方赌场（原创扩展；具体细部待考）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep this exact Qing gray-brick two-storey gambling-house sprite, its orthographic camera, beautiful material textures, gray tiled roofs, enclosed front court, wooden gate and lanterns. Make ONLY a measured dimensional correction. The front ground width is currently721px and right-side ground depth637px, ratio1.132; target ratio is1.250 (10m wide x8m deep). Extend the front boundary wall and rear hall facade / roof width together; retain the side depth and correct slopes+0.50/-0.50. The front wall must become noticeably wider than the receding side by25%, not remain square. Do not change yaw, pitch, side length or vertical wall height. Uniformly zoom out to contain entire new footprint with clear transparent margin as necessary. Do not distort pixels; rebuild the geometry with coherent bricks/windows/roof. Actual transparent RGBA background alpha0, solid materials alpha255, no haze, no halo, no background floor outside boundary, no tall plinth, no text, watermarks, people, modern objects. ONE complete single historical realistic building sprite, 10:8 rectangle footprint.
